sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioner prays for and is allowed to implead the informant as opposite party no.2 in course of the day.
2. Heard the parties.

3. The petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Kuchaikote P.S. Case No. 10 of 2021 instituted under Sections 406, 420 of the Indian Penal Code and section 138 of N.I. Act lodged on 07.01.2021 by the informant, Sudhansu Kumar Mishra.

4. Issue notice to newly added opposite party no.2 both by registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks from today failing which this application shall stand rejected without Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.49421 of 2024(2)
dt.14-08-2024 further reference to a Bench.
5.

In case, the order passed is not complied and the matter accordingly stands rejected, the same be posted under the heading "To be Mentioned" alongwith 'Tied Up' matters before the Bench on the 'Tied Up' day.
